run.Original_Project_description: The Third Party Annotation (TPA) assembly was derived from the primary whole genome shotgun (WGS) data set PRJEB3227, and was assembled with SPAdes v3.14.1. This project includes samples from the following biomes: root:Host-associated:Human:Digestive system:Large intestine:Fecal.
